passive_transferred.confirmed: the core's owner, from the code (core-next, 16 November 2026)
passive_transferred.says: inward-positive: a positive amount moves from the route's outside end (its patch's outside node, or its junction's receiver) into its inside end (its patch's cell, or its junction's sender)

transporter_cycle_rate_fmol_s.says: a positive cycle moves n (the stoichiometry) of the role from the patch's cell to its outside node; held fuel's maintenance restores its ATP (transporter_fuel_supplied_fmol)

transporter_cycles.says: a positive cycle moves n (the stoichiometry) of the role from the patch's cell to its outside node; held fuel's maintenance restores its ATP (transporter_fuel_supplied_fmol)

citation.licence: no numbers taken: the law is a form, its parameters a definition's values

fields.basis: the Goldman-Hodgkin-Katz constant-field flux of each permeant species (coupling/selective.selective_flux)

formulas.g_join_i(n): 1 + x_i / N, on n (the state without the moving molecule); 1 when N = 0
formulas.g_leave_i(n): 1 + (x_i - beta_ii) / (N - 1), on n - e_i (the state without the leaving molecule), when N >= 2 and n_i >= 1; 1 otherwise (the last molecule leaves uncatalysed; a type with n_i = 0 has no leave)
formulas.last_molecule: the last molecule's leave (N = 1, n_i = 1) carries 1: no catalyst remains (this form only; the single-event form's carries 1 + beta_ii)
formulas.replay: a replay that recomputes x at every event agrees with the incremental x to rounding: event sequences exactly (but for a threshold coincidence at rounding), times to a relative 1e-15
formulas.state: x = beta n, x_i = sum_j beta_ij n_j: a serial left fold over j in declared order, computed exactly for the founder and for each followed daughter
formulas.update: after an event of type i with sign s (+1 join, -1 leave): x <- x + s * beta[:, i]

fields.note: GARD comparison law set (D192, D197): for comparison with the Plastic Heredity preprint's reconstructed GARD only; Cells' own origin-of-life laws are derived from physical chemistry. The pair-consistent form, passive: the leaving molecule does not catalyse its own leave, so the chain keeps the beta-independent equilibrium exactly.

departures: the factor of a transfer is evaluated on the assembly without the moving molecule, so a transfer and its reverse see the same catalysts (GARD_DESIGN §1.4, 2)

citation.source: Segre, Ben-Eli and Lancet (2000), PNAS 97:4112; Plastic Heredity preprint v5.0, Appendix F (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22143269)

formulas.g_join_i(n): 1 + x_i / N, at the current state; 1 when N = 0
formulas.g_leave_i(n): 1 + x_i / N, at the current state (the leaving molecule counted); 1 when N = 0
formulas.last_molecule: the last molecule's leave (N = 1, n_i = 1) carries 1 + beta_ii: the molecule catalyses its own leave
formulas.replay: a replay that recomputes x at every event agrees with the incremental x to rounding: event sequences exactly (but for a threshold coincidence at rounding), times to a relative 1e-15

formulas.update: after an event of type i with sign s (+1 join, -1 leave): x <- x + s * beta[:, i]

fields.note: GARD comparison law set (D192, D197): for comparison with the Plastic Heredity preprint's reconstructed GARD only; Cells' own origin-of-life laws are derived from physical chemistry. The preprint's single-event form, kept for the reference comparison and declared driven: in a closed two-type world it generically fails Kolmogorov's cycle criterion (a rank-one matrix is the exception). The original authors' kernel is not established either way, and the preprint's driven runs are not affected.

formulas.F_id: sum_dilute sum_s [n_s (mu°_s,sol - ln X) + ln n_s!] + sum_i n_i mu°_i,bil - ln (N - c)! + sum_i ln n_i!, X = N_A V c0; held species: no term
formulas.empty_membrane: the membrane's term is 0 at N = 0 under both measures
formulas.measure: c = 0 (multinomial) or 1 (multinomial_less_one, @1's measure = multinomial + ln N)

departures: exact in the counts (ln n!), not Stirling's form: the discrete form in which the reverse rate derived from F is the products' mass action
the condensed measure is declared: the multinomial, or @1's (multinomial plus ln N)
citation.place: the pool and assembly terms of the one free-energy function
citation.source: docs/ORIGIN_OF_LIFE_ENGINE_DESIGN.md §2.2 and §0.2a (standard statistical mechanics of ideal dilute solutions and ideal mixtures)

formulas.F_reg: (1/(2N)) sum_ij chi_ij n_i n_j over the membrane's species; 0 at N = 0
formulas.change: S' = S + 2 d.y + d.chi d, N' = N + sum d over the membrane
formulas.chi: symmetric (Maxwell), zero diagonal, finite, k_BT; unlisted pairs 0
formulas.role: excess: the reverse rate carries exp(F_reg(n) - F_reg(n - nu))
formulas.state: y = chi n, S = n.y, exactly by serial folds at the founder

departures: written in counts, (1/(2N)) sum chi n n, with a symmetric chi and a zero diagonal
citation.place: the regular solution: an excess free energy quadratic in the composition
citation.source: Hildebrand (1929), J Am Chem Soc 51:66; docs/ORIGIN_OF_LIFE_ENGINE_DESIGN.md §2.2, §2.5 and probe E2

fields.changes: one molecule of one type per event: +1 (join) or -1 (leave), from or to the held phase

formulas.affinity_i(n): ln theta_i + ln N - ln(n_i + 1), theta_i = K_i rho_i, for n <-> n + e_i
formulas.join_i: kf_i * rho_i * N, with kf_i = K_i * kb_i (the type family's transfer constant)

fields.reads: the assembly's counts n_i and size N; the held activities rho_i

departures: the join constant is derived from the type's transfer constant (one authority)

citation.source: Segre, Ben-Eli and Lancet (2000), PNAS 97:4112; Plastic Heredity preprint v5.0, Appendix F (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22143269)

formulas.extent: E(m) = X_locus = N_A V_locus c0 for a dilute locus; N(m) - c + 1 for the membrane (membrane_kinetics count_on_m)
formulas.forward: a+(n) = k_f E(m) prod_dilute ff(n_p, a_p)/X_p^a_p prod_held (c_s/c0)^a_s prod_membrane ff(n_i, a_i)/ff(N - c, r), m = min(n, n + nu)
formulas.kept: rate 0 only for a pair whose step changes the membrane's count and one of whose end states has an empty membrane; every other step fires at its own rate
formulas.membrane_factor: E(m)/ff(N - c, r) = (N - c - r* + 1)/ff(N - c, r), cancelled to 1/ff(N - c, r - 1) where r* = r >= 1 (sec. 0.2a): the last molecule's leave is k-.1 under last_molecule extinct
formulas.reverse: the same law applied to the products, with k- = k_f exp(sum_p nu_p mu°_p), times exp(F_ex(n) - F_ex(n - nu)) for the excess terms; identical to the pair rule a-(n + nu) = s(m) theta+(n) exp(F(n + nu) - F(n) - w)
formulas.units: k_f in 1/s (the activity form, D152's forward_rate_per_s)

departures: the reverse propensity is derived from the one free energy F, never declared
a membrane (condensed phase) has no volume until OL2: its reactants' activities are drawn without replacement, and the locus extent is evaluated on the pair's common state
the rate constant is D152's forward_rate_per_s, in the activity form

formulas.common_state: m = min(n, n + nu) elementwise: z_r(m) = z_r(n) - sum_e beta_r,e (n_e - m_e), N_cat(m) = N - r*
formulas.empty_catalyst_phase: g = 1 where the catalysing phase is empty at m (uncatalysed)
formulas.g_r(m): 1 + sum_j beta_rj x_j(m), x_j = m_j / N_cat(m), beta_rj = exp(ddG_rj) - 1 > -1; the same factor for both directions of the pair
formulas.state: z = beta n, exactly at the founder; one column of beta per entry moved

departures: single-contact stabilisation in an ideal mixture, evaluated on the pair's common state m: g = 1 + sum beta x(m), beta = exp(ddG) - 1

contract.carrier_keys: the founder holds 0:0; each fission gives its first daughter the next key of its parent's counter and its second the one after; the followed daughter continues the counter and becomes the slot's occupant (keys.py)
contract.empty: extinct: an empty pick is followed and the lineage ends; other: an empty pick moves to the other daughter when it holds a molecule
contract.uniform: the continuation stream's draw u at counter 0: u < 1/2 picks the first daughter, otherwise the second

fields.energy_role: none of its own: the unfollowed daughter's -k_BT ln pi leaves to the sink
fields.reads: the two daughters of a fission
fields.stream: continuation: one uniform, from the parent's carrier key (rule uniform only)
fields.writes: the slot's occupant, generation and carrier keys; the discarded material

citation.place: the continued daughter: first (T2-02), second (T1-03), either with probability 1/2 with a nonempty fallback (T2-03)
citation.source: Plastic Heredity preprint v5.0, Appendix F, contracts T2-02, T1-03 and T2-03 (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22143269)

reaction_affinity_RT.says: A/RT, the reactants' chemical potential less the products' over RT (minus the reaction's free energy over RT): positive drives a passive route forward, zero at its equilibrium; 0 on driven routes

reaction_extent_fmol.says: a positive extent is net forward progress since the start: the route has turned its reactants into its products; a driven route's is zero or more
reaction_extent_fmol.source: species_reactions' half-step: dxi = h (J(Y1) + J(Y2) + 4 J(Y3)) / 6

reaction_rate_fmol_per_s.says: a positive rate runs the route forward, its reactants into its products; a passive route's is its forward flux less its reverse flux, a driven route's is zero or more

exchange_moved_fmol.says: a positive amount leaves the cell of the route's patch for that patch's outside node: an export route's total is zero or more, an import route's zero or less

contract.binomial: an occupied place k goes to the first daughter when u_k < p
contract.draw: M uniforms u_0 .. u_(M-1), the partition stream's draw at counter 0, keyed by the parent's carrier key (one per place; only the occupied places' are read)
contract.exact_fraction: take = floor(f * N) in float64; rank the occupied places by u_k ascending, ties by place; the first `take` places go to the first daughter
contract.places: M = execution.molecule_capacity molecule places, by type in declared order: places 0 .. n_0 - 1 hold type 0, the next n_1 type 1, and so on; places N .. M - 1 are empty
contract.second_daughter: the parent less the first daughter
contract.trigger: a join that brings the size N to `size` (exact: single-molecule events); a daughter born with N = `size` (a binomial partition can give one daughter every molecule) splits at once, at its birth, before any event (the horizon first: a daughter at the fission limit is not split)

fields.energy_role: work: the split's change in -k_BT ln pi, from an unmodelled agent (signed)
fields.reads: the assembly's size N (current) and its counts
fields.stream: partition: one uniform per molecule place, from the parent's carrier key
fields.writes: the slot's composition: the followed daughter replaces the parent (continuation)

citation.place: exact-size multivariate-hypergeometric split, floor(N/2) to the first daughter
citation.source: Plastic Heredity preprint v5.0, Appendix F, contract T2-02 (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22143269)
